actions.desc: The angel feasts on the departing life energy of a humanoid within 5 feet. The target must have been slain within the last hour. The angel magically gains temporary hit points equal to half the dead creatures maximum hit points. These hit points last until depleted. Only a spell cast with a 9th-level slot can raise the corpse from the dead.

actions.desc: The solar speaks an echoing command. Each creature of the solars choice within 30 feet that can hear the solar and understands a language makes a DC 24 Charisma saving throw. Each creature that succeeds on the saving throw takes 21 (6d6) thunder damage. Each creature that fails its saving throw immediately takes a certain action, depending on the solars command. This is a magical charm effect.

Характеристики: СИЛ 28, ЛОВ 22, ТЕЛ 28, ИНТ 22, МУД 30, ХАР 30. Уязвимость к урону: излучением. Сопротивление урону: дробящего, колющего, излучением, рубящего. Иммунитет к урону: некротической энергией, ядом. Иммунитет к состояниям: очарование, истощение, испуг, отравление. Чувства: пассивное Восприятие 27. Показатель опасности: 21.
